items.name: theme
items.title: pyospect theme
items.description: 4px grid, neutral surfaces, one warm green brand scale, Pretendard. Rules in docs/TASTE.md.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: primary, secondary, ghost, tint. full radius, one primary per screen, labels are verbs.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: surface with a meaningful 1px line. Field, Label, Help included. label always on top.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: track 28, handle 20, padding 4. Control row keeps label and switch on one line.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: surface level. no border, no shadow, never inside another card. media radius = card radius minus padding.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: full radius pill. colored tones are solid with white text.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: the only place a shadow lives. title is a question, primary button is the answer.

items.name: thinking
items.title: Thinking
items.description: the agent's collapsible reasoning block. live dot pulses, done title is past tense.

items.name: validation-card
items.title: ValidationCard
items.description: one check the agent ran: title, one-line reason, status tag.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: filled circle = the agent handles it, dashed circle = a person decides. legend included.

items.name: decision-card
items.title: DecisionCard
items.description: what the agent made and the ways forward. the person presses to move on.
